decisions.Kwic: 從上佛祖皆見有付法偈

Decision.AttributionNote: 介菴進禪師語錄, preface to Jie'an Wujin's verses on transmission sources. Jie'an Wujin is the exact speaker: responding to disciples' request, he says that former buddhas and patriarchs are all seen to have Dharma-transmission verses and then explains why he records their transmission phrases.
